sample_source: Frozen tissue samples from BD20 were sectioned on a cryostat into 10 µm thick slices (approximately 6 × 6 mm), placed into a 96 well plate and stored at −80 °C until further use.
age: Average age ± standard deviation (range) at diagnosis of lymph node metastasis was 62.4 ± 13.7 (25–89) years.
